summary: OpenCode Zen lists Exo Free (model ID exo-free) with free input, output and cached reads. It is available for a limited time, with no end date stated. Use it for coding in OpenCode or through the OpenAI-compatible Zen API. During the free period, collected data may be used to improve the model; avoid sending sensitive or confidential material. Account enrollment and an Exo API request were not completed, so this entry records published pricing rather than firsthand delivered access.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Zen and obtain your API key. General Zen instructions include adding billing details; an Exo-specific payment-method requirement is unconfirmed.
In OpenCode, run /connect, select OpenCode Zen and enter your API key locally.
Run /models and select Exo Free (model ID: exo-free). Alternatively, use exo-free with https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions.
During the free period, collected data may be used to improve the model. Avoid sensitive inputs and check current pricing before use; the offer is limited-time.
